title: trailboss --json team stop
description: What `team stop <n>` does (no --yes: `would …`): the team stopped, so no more members start; each member task that hasn't started taken back; each member still running named for you to close. It types nothing, ends no process and removes no work: `task accept` and `task rm` stay yours.

action.description: stop, took back, note or failed, each as `would …` without --yes; more may be added.

member.description: The member a row is about, `role (task n)`; null for the team's own row.
